name: Default Flashcard & Trivia Quiz
description: Comprehensive trivia dataset with 5 core rounds and 40+ questions.

divisions.title: Round 1 — General Trivia
divisions.subtitle: Warm-up round. Easy to medium difficulty.

divisions.title: Round 2 — Rapid Fire
divisions.subtitle: Seconds on the clock. Trust your instincts!
divisions.scoreRule: +10 flat + speed bonus for quick answers

divisions.title: Round 3 — Buzzer Round
divisions.subtitle: Step-by-step clues revealed one by one. First to spot it wins!

divisions.title: Round 4 — Connect the Dots
divisions.subtitle: Analyze the sequence of 4 clues and find the hidden connection.

divisions.title: Round 5 — Audience Round
divisions.subtitle: For the whole room. Everyone plays, everyone can score!

questions.question: Which app's logo is a white paper airplane on a blue background?
questions.explanation: Telegram's iconic logo features a sleek white paper plane inside a bright blue circle.

questions.question: What does the term 'AI' stand for?
questions.explanation: AI stands for Artificial Intelligence, referring to machines and systems designed to mimic human cognitive processes.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a real Instagram feature — Reels, Stories, Snaps, or Close Friends?
questions.explanation: Snaps is a feature and term exclusive to Snapchat, whereas Reels, Stories, and Close Friends are Instagram features.

questions.question: Which Indian city is nicknamed the 'Silicon Valley of India'?
questions.explanation: Bengaluru (Bangalore) earned this nickname as India's leading IT exporter and technology innovation hub.

questions.question: Which tech giant was originally named 'BackRub' before its famous rebrand?
questions.explanation: Larry Page and Sergey Brin originally named their search engine 'BackRub' in 1996 because it analyzed web backlinks before renaming it Google.

questions.question: Every slide of this quiz has one word on it somewhere — what's the name of today's orientation program?
questions.explanation: 'Deeksharambh' is the official student induction and orientation program designed to welcome freshers to KRMU!

questions.question: True or False: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
questions.explanation: False — it's a popular myth. NASA astronauts have confirmed the Great Wall cannot be seen without magnification in low Earth orbit.

questions.question: Which country is credited with sending the world's first emoji out into the wild, back in 1999?
questions.explanation: Shigetaka Kurita created the first set of 176 emojis in 1999 for Japanese mobile operator NTT DoCoMo.

questions.question: Which programming language was created by Brendan Eich in just 10 days in 1995?
questions.explanation: Brendan Eich created Netscape's LiveScript (later renamed JavaScript) in May 1995 in just 10 days!

questions.question: What does 'HTTP' stand for in web address URLs?
questions.explanation: HTTP stands for HyperText Transfer Protocol, the foundational protocol used to transfer web pages across the internet.

questions.question: Which revolutionary AI chatbot released in late 2022 became the fastest consumer app to reach 100M users?
questions.explanation: OpenAI's ChatGPT launched in November 2022 and reached 100 million active users in just two months!

questions.question: What is the name of GitHub's famous cat-octopus mascot?
questions.explanation: Monalisa the Octocat is GitHub's iconic mascot, featuring an octopus head with a cat face!

questions.question: Which operating system mascot is a penguin named 'Tux'?
questions.explanation: Tux the penguin was created by Larry Ewing in 1996 as the official brand mascot of the Linux kernel.

questions.question: Which tech giant acquired GitHub for $7.5 Billion in 2018?
questions.explanation: Microsoft acquired GitHub in June 2018 to support open-source software development and cloud workflows.

questions.question: What does 'CPU' stand for in computer hardware?
questions.explanation: The CPU (Central Processing Unit) is the core processor often called the 'brain' of the computer.

questions.question: Which social media platform uses a ghost mascot named 'Ghostface Chillah'?
questions.explanation: Snapchat's famous white ghost mascot on a yellow background is named Ghostface Chillah!

questions.question: Either/Or: Instagram or Snapchat — which app launched first?
questions.explanation: Instagram launched in October 2010, whereas Snapchat launched nearly a year later in July 2011.

questions.question: What's the name of the tech company that started as an online bookstore and is now named after a rainforest?
questions.explanation: Jeff Bezos founded Amazon in 1994 as an online marketplace for books before expanding into e-commerce, cloud, and tech.

questions.question: Either/Or: iOS or Android — which one is open-source?
questions.explanation: Android's core code is released under the Android Open Source Project (AOSP), whereas iOS is proprietary.

questions.question: What is the capital city of Japan?
questions.explanation: Tokyo has been the capital city and seat of government of Japan since 1868.

questions.question: Identify: Which global tech brand's logo features a bitten apple?
questions.explanation: Rob Janoff designed Apple's famous bitten apple logo in 1977 so it wouldn't be mistaken for a cherry.

questions.question: Which messaging app features a green icon with a white phone receiver?
questions.explanation: WhatsApp's green icon featuring a phone inside a speech bubble is used by over 2 billion users worldwide.

questions.question: In what year did India gain independence from British rule?
questions.explanation: India achieved independence at midnight on August 15, 1947.

questions.question: Either/Or: Cricket or Kabaddi — which one originated in India?
questions.explanation: Kabaddi is an ancient contact sport that originated in India thousands of years ago, while Cricket originated in England.

questions.question: Identify this iconic Superhero based on progressive clues:
clues: Bitten by a spider during a school trip — not born with alien powers
Balances being a high school student with a secret crime-fighting life
His motto is: 'With great power comes great responsibility'
Wears a red and blue suit and swings on webs between New York skyscrapers
questions.explanation: Peter Parker gained superhero abilities after being bitten by a radioactive spider in a lab accident.

questions.question: Identify this global Brand based on progressive clues:
clues: Its iconic single-line logo is a simple 'Swoosh'
Named after the ancient Greek goddess of victory
Famous worldwide for Air Jordans and its slogan 'Just Do It'
The world's leading sports footwear and athletic brand
questions.explanation: Nike was named after the Greek goddess of victory, and Carolyn Davidson created its iconic swoosh logo in 1971.

questions.question: Identify this blockbuster Movie based on progressive clues:
clues: Set on a distant alien moon named Pandora filled with bioluminescent forests
Humans connect their minds to tall, blue-skinned native bodies called Na'vi
Directed by James Cameron, it became the highest-grossing film of all time ($2.9B+)
The 3D sci-fi epic featuring Jake Sully and Neytiri
questions.explanation: Released in 2009 by James Cameron, Avatar broke all global box office records.

questions.question: Identify this tech Company / Platform based on progressive clues:
clues: Pioneered hashtags (#), trending topics, and viral retweets
Famous for its original strict 140-character text limit per post
Elon Musk bought this social platform for $44 Billion
Rebranded from the iconic blue bird logo to the letter 'X' in 2023
questions.explanation: Twitter rebranded to 'X' in July 2023 under Elon Musk, replacing the classic blue bird logo.

questions.question: Identify this global Event based on progressive clues:
clues: Held once every 4 years with top athletes competing for Gold, Silver, and Bronze
Opens with a legendary sacred torch relay across the host country
Its official emblem features 5 interlocking colorful rings
Paris hosted the recent 2024 edition of this global sports spectacle
questions.explanation: The Olympic Games gather top athletes worldwide every four years, with Paris hosting the 2024 Summer Olympics.

questions.question: Identify this tech Legend based on progressive clues:
clues: Traveled across India in the 1970s seeking spiritual enlightenment before launching a tech empire
Co-founded Apple in a family garage and was famous for wearing a black turtleneck
Was ousted from his own company, then returned to save it with the iMac & iPod
Unveiled the very first revolutionary iPhone on stage in 2007
questions.explanation: Steve Jobs co-founded Apple in 1976, revolutionizing personal computers, digital music, and smartphones.

questions.question: Java → Python → Ruby → Swift → ?
questions.explanation: All items in this sequence are popular high-level computer programming languages!

questions.question: Titanic → Avatar → Avengers: Endgame → Star Wars: The Force Awakens → ?
options: All won Oscar Best Picture awards
All ranked among the Highest-Grossing Films of All Time
All were directed by James Cameron
All were filmed in New Zealand
questions.explanation: Every film listed has grossed over $2 Billion worldwide, occupying top positions on the all-time box office chart.

questions.question: Bengaluru → Hyderabad → Pune → Gurugram → ?
options: Major Coastal Port Cities of India
All major IT & Tech Hub Cities in India
questions.explanation: These 4 Indian cities form the primary backbone of India's technology, software exports, and tech startup ecosystem.

questions.question: Elon Musk → Jeff Bezos → Richard Branson → ?
options: Billionaires who built their own private space companies
questions.explanation: Musk (SpaceX), Bezos (Blue Origin), and Branson (Virgin Galactic) are all billionaires funding private space exploration.

questions.question: Raise your hand if you've ever nodded along to a meme you didn't actually understand!
questions.explanation: No wrong answers — full marks for honesty! Memes evolve faster than college schedules.

questions.question: Closest guess wins: roughly how many new students got admitted to KRMU this year?
questions.explanation: KRMU welcomed over 4,500+ bright new freshers across various undergraduate and postgraduate programs!

questions.question: Guess it: how many hours a day do you think the average college student spends on their phone?
questions.explanation: Studies show college students spend roughly 6 to 8 hours daily on smartphones for learning and entertainment!

questions.question: Which social media platform introduced short-form video 'Reels' in 2020?
questions.explanation: Instagram launched Reels in August 2020 to allow users to create and discover short, entertaining videos.

questions.question: Which traditional beverage is celebrated as the ultimate daily energizer across Indian college campuses?
questions.explanation: Masala Chai is the ultimate staple energizer across Indian college canteens and campus hangouts!

questions.question: What is considered the most effective way to make the most of your fresher year during orientation?
questions.explanation: Active networking and joining campus clubs is the best way to thrive and build lifelong connections during college!
